accessibility:
- **The field is a combobox that opens a dialog,** as the date pickers' is: `role="combobox"`
  with `aria-haspopup="dialog"`, `aria-expanded`, and `aria-controls` while the panel is open,
  named by its `label`. It's read-only, and in `'single'` its value is the picked item's label.
  In the checkbox modes it's described by the tags.
- **Keys on the field:** a click, Enter, Space, Down or Alt+Down opens the panel, and with
  `searchable` a printable key opens it with that key in the search box.
- **The panel** is a non-modal `dialog`, named by the label or `labels.choose`. Focus moves into
  it as it opens: onto the picked item, its branch open, or onto the search box when
  `searchable`, or else onto the first item. It holds focus while it's open, as the date
  pickers' panel does: Tab and Shift+Tab move between the search box and the tree, and wrap.
  Escape and Alt+Up close it and put focus back on the field, and so does a pick in `'single'`.
  A press outside closes it and leaves focus where the press put it.
- **The tree** is TreeView's, with the same name as the panel: real focus with one tab stop, the
  arrow keys, Home, End, `*` and type-ahead, Right and Left swapped on a right-to-left page,
  `aria-level`, `aria-posinset` and `aria-setsize` on every item, `aria-selected` in `'single'`,
  `aria-checked` in the checkbox modes (`"mixed"` only in `'checkbox'`), and disabled items
  reachable and `aria-disabled`. See [`TreeView`](https://bestax.io/docs/api/components/treeview#accessibility).
- **The search box** is named "Search", or `labels.search`. When nothing matches, `empty` is said
  once through a polite status region, not again on every key.
- **Each tag's button** is a `Delete` named "Remove" and the item's label, or `ariaCloseLabel`
  described by the tag's label.
- **`required`** makes the field `aria-required`. A read-only field is left out of the browser's
  own check, so a hidden field the browser reads carries `required`, and it hands focus to the
  real one when the browser points at it.
- **Forced colors:** the field, the panel and the tree keep their edges in system colors, and the
  chevron is text.
summary: The `TreeSelect` component is a form field whose options are a tree, such as categories, places or teams: it opens a panel holding a real `TreeView`, picks one item or checks a branch at a time, and searches labels. The field is a read-only `role="combobox"` that opens a dialog, wired as DateInput's is, so focus moves into the tree for real and the tree keeps TreeView's keys, type-ahead and spoken output. The tree is given as `data`, so the field and the tags can name what's picked while the panel is shut, and on the server. `selectionMode` picks the kind. `'single'` picks one item and closes. With `'checkbox'`, a check reaches every enabled item under it, closed or hidden by a search, and `checkedStrategy` decides what the value holds: the leaves, the topmost checked items or every one. With `'checkbox-independent'`, each box is its own item's, so a parent means itself alone (Mantine's and Ant Design's `checkStrictly`). The value shows as tags under the field. A value no node has is kept and shown as it is, with a warning in development, so a value under a branch that hasn't loaded survives until it does.

parts.summary: The `TreeSelect` component is a form field whose options are a tree, such as categories, places or teams: it opens a panel holding a real `TreeView`, picks one item or checks a branch at a time, and searches labels. The field is a read-only `role="combobox"` that opens a dialog, wired as DateInput's is, so focus moves into the tree for real and the tree keeps TreeView's keys, type-ahead and spoken output. The tree is given as `data`, so the field and the tags can name what's picked while the panel is shut, and on the server. `selectionMode` picks the kind. `'single'` picks one item and closes. With `'checkbox'`, a check reaches every enabled item under it, closed or hidden by a search, and `checkedStrategy` decides what the value holds: the leaves, the topmost checked items or every one. With `'checkbox-independent'`, each box is its own item's, so a parent means itself alone (Mantine's and Ant Design's `checkStrictly`). The value shows as tags under the field. A value no node has is kept and shown as it is, with a warning in development, so a value under a branch that hasn't loaded survives until it does.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: `'single'`: one item, picked with Enter, Space or a click on its row. `'checkbox'`: any number, with a box on every item. A check reaches every enabled item under it, and a parent with some of them checked is mixed. `'checkbox-independent'`: any number, each box checking its own item, so a parent means the parent alone (Mantine's and Ant Design's `checkStrictly`). The checkbox modes show the value as tags.

props.name: value
props.description: The value when you hold the state: in `'single'` the picked item's value, or `null` for none, and in the checkbox modes the checked values. In `'checkbox'` a parent's value checks its whole branch, so the list any `checkedStrategy` gives checks the same boxes.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value to begin with, when TreeSelect holds its own state: a value or `null`, or a list in the checkbox modes.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new value: in `'single'` the picked item's value, or `null` when it's cleared, and in the checkbox modes the new list, after a check, an uncheck, a tag's button or the clear button.

props.name: parentsSelectable
props.description: A parent's row picks the parent. `false` makes the row, Enter and Space open it instead, so only leaves are picked.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Closes the panel after a pick and puts focus back on the field.

props.name: checkedStrategy
props.description: What a checked branch puts in the value, in `'checkbox'`: `'child'` its leaves, `'parent'` its topmost checked item, `'all'` every checked item, parents included. A checked disabled item is in all three, since only its own value checks it. It shapes the value a check, an uncheck or a tag's button makes, which `onChange` reports. The tags and the hidden inputs show the value as it's held, so a value you pass shows as you pass it, and a branch that loads later changes nothing the form posts. `'checkbox-independent'` always reports exactly the checked items.

props.name: ariaCloseLabel
props.description: Names each tag's button, in place of "Remove" and the item's label, as on Combobox.

props.name: data
props.description: **Required.** The tree, as nodes nested through `children`.

props.name: label
props.description: The field's label, which names the field through `htmlFor`, and the panel and the tree in it through `aria-labelledby`. Dropped inside an outer `Field`, whose label names them instead.

props.name: id
props.description: The field's `id`, which the label then points at. The panel's is this one with `-panel` after it.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the field, and the panel and the tree, in place of a `label`.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The ids of what names the field, and the panel and the tree, in place of a `label`.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: The ids of what describes the field, ahead of the tags.

props.name: expanded
props.description: The open branches' values when you hold the state, as TreeView's `expanded`.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: The branches open to begin with, when TreeSelect holds its own state.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called with the new list whenever a branch opens or closes, opening the panel on the picked item's branch included. Fetch a lazy branch's children from here. The branches a search opens aren't in it.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the panel is open, controlled: opening and closing then only call `onOpenChange`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The panel is open to begin with.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the panel opens or closes.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Puts a search box at the top of the panel. It matches labels, keeps a match's ancestors and the nodes under it, and opens every branch with a match. A printable key on the field opens the panel with it in the box, and the search empties when the panel closes.

props.name: query
props.description: The search text when you hold the state.

props.name: defaultQuery
props.description: The search text to begin with.

props.name: onQueryChange
props.description: Called with the search text as it changes.

props.name: filter
props.description: Whether a node matches the search, in place of the locale-aware match on its label. It's handed the search text trimmed. A match's ancestors stay either way.

props.name: empty
props.description: What the panel shows when the search matches nothing, such as "No folders match". Announced once.

props.name: itemTemplate
props.description: Renders a row's content in place of its label. The field and the tags still show the label.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: What the field shows while nothing is picked.

props.name: name
props.description: A form field name. A hidden input posts the value, or one per value in the checkbox modes.

props.name: form
props.description: The id of the form the hidden inputs belong to, when it isn't an ancestor.

props.name: required
props.description: A value is needed: the field is `aria-required`, and the form won't submit while nothing is picked. The browser's message points at the field, and focus goes to it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The field can't be used: it can't be focused or opened, its tags lose their buttons, and its hidden inputs don't post.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Shows a clear button at the field's inline end while something it can take off is picked. It leaves checked disabled items, which no control unchecks.

props.name: color
props.description: Bulma color modifier for the field.

props.name: size
props.description: The field's size, which the tree in the panel follows.

props.name: isRounded
props.description: Rounds the field's corners (Bulma's `is-rounded`).

props.name: position
props.description: Where the panel opens, relative to the field, as on the pickers.

props.name: appendToBody
props.description: Renders the panel through a portal, into a `ConfigProvider`'s `portalContainer`, `document.body` by default.

props.name: labels
props.type: { choose?: string; search?: string; clear?: string }
props.description: The visible and accessible strings, in your app's language.

props.name: loadingLabel
props.description: What a loading branch's row says, as on TreeView. In your app's language.

props.name: retryLabel
props.description: The Retry button's text on a failed load's row, as on TreeView. In your app's language.

props.name: loadingAnnouncement
props.description: What the live region says when an open branch starts loading, as on TreeView.

props.name: loadedAnnouncement
props.description: What the live region says when that load finishes, as on TreeView.

props.name: labelSize
props.description: Size for the label (used in horizontal layouts).

props.name: labelProps
props.description: Props for the label element.

props.name: horizontal
props.description: Horizontal field layout.

props.name: message
props.description: Help/validation message below the input.

props.name: messageColor
props.description: Bulma color for the message.

props.name: fieldClassName
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the Field wrapper.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

extraProps.name: ref
extraProps.description: Ref forwarded to the field, the read-only `<input role="combobox">`.

parts.catchAll: All standard <div> attributes and Bulma helper props
